svg.aria-label: Keeping watch on AI. A burst chart of the SafeAI.watch record: 691 dated, sourced entries from Mar 2023 to Nov 2026, one dot each: 133 warnings, 178 incidents, 170 governance, 210 research. Distance from the centre is the entry's date; dashed rings mark January 1. The record is a selection, so density shows what it covers, not how often things happen.

svg.text: A dated record of AI safety and security
research, incidents, warnings, and policy. Each
entry links its original source, gives its key
points, and separates what happened from what
ONE DOT PER ENTRY · FARTHER OUT = NEWER
A SELECTION · DENSITY SHOWS COVERAGE, NOT FREQUENCY
